summary: Join our Fleet Maintenance and Management Course to master effective strategies for managing and maintaining your fleet efficiently and cost-effectively.
lede: Fleet management training helps fleet managers, maintenance supervisors, and transport and logistics professionals organize vehicle maintenance, inspections, costs, and performance. It covers creating preventive maintenance schedules and inspection routines, managing workshops, vendors, parts, and fuel, and analyzing costs and recurring faults to inform repair and replacement decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals responsible for fleet availability, maintenance, compliance, and cost performance.
audience: Public sector transport officers and procurement teams
modules: Foundations of Fleet Maintenance and Management
Fleet Asset Inventory, Classification, and Baseline Condition
Preventive Maintenance Planning That Works in Real Life
Daily and Periodic Inspections, Roadworthiness, and Documentation
Spare Parts, Inventory Control, and Procurement Discipline
Fuel Management, Utilization, and Driver Behavior
Breakdown Management, Root Cause Analysis, and Corrective Actions
Fleet Performance Data, KPIs, and Dashboards
Lifecycle Planning, Replacement Strategy, and Total Cost of Ownership
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in fleet management or related fields. Familiarity with basic fleet operations and maintenance processes is recommended.
